# Team Live Ops

INTEGRATED SYSTEM: this skill belongs to the complete "Claude Code Game Studios" template (49 agents, 74 skills, templates and a studio CLAUDE.md); it assumes that template and its conventions. This listing installs only this skill's folder, without the rest of the system, and the skill may reference template agents or files that are absent outside the full template. It orchestrates the live-ops team to plan one season or live event: scoping and retention hook, narrative theme, an economy design on paper (free and premium reward tiers, seasonal currency, store rotation and prices, pity timers, with an explicit no-pay-to-win check), analytics and A/B test specifications, player-facing writing, and a communication calendar of drafts. Nothing is published, sent or charged. The final review checks the economy against the project's ethics policy — a missing policy is flagged as a skipped review, a violation blocks the plan. At the default team size the live-ops-designer and economy-designer run; wider sizes add the other four agents.
